title: Official Metadata Addon Provider Extension Decentralization
problem: Provider extension still leaks provider-specific config, external ID alias, and rendered-page support facts through central modules.

evidence.summary: Workstream opened from user-approved follow-on provider extension refactor Goal.
ProviderConfig now uses typed provider config variants and provider-local config structs live in provider modules while public env and manifest compatibility is preserved.

continue_policy.notes: Continue through provider config decentralization, provider-owned external ID aliases, rendered-page support semantics, cleanup, integration, and closeout. Do not add live smoke or release work to this lane.
